newsitem.title: USA: CBOT wheat ends mixed, nearbys down on fund sale.
newsitem.headline: CBOT wheat ends mixed, nearbys down on fund sale.

text.p: CBOT wheat futures closed mixed with nearby contracts lower on aggressive fund selling, traders said.
Traders said Smith Barney sold 10 million bushels of December.
The market was seeking direction after Wednesday's late slide, led by a rumor Egypt had cancelled a cargo of U.S. wheat, traders said.
A Cairo trader overnight said the rumors probably arose from routine delays to wheat or flour cargoes for health inspection.

Wheat was underpinned by a strong export sales number in USDA's weekly export sales report. USDA early Thursday said wheat export sales for the week ended September 26 were at 585,100 tonnes, up 58 percent from the previous week.
Wheat futures volume was estimated at 15,000, down from 18,839 Wednesday, according to the CBOT.
Wheat options volume was estimated at 4,500, up from 4,249 Wednesday.
Wheat futures closed 2-1/2 cents per bushel lower to three higher, with December down 2-1/2 at $4.20.
